objectives: Students will be able to define the impact of cognition and particularly the learning process.
Students will be able to analyze how cultural and learner differences influence cognition and the educational process.
Students will understand the Behavioral, Cognitive, and Constructivist views of learning.
Students will be able to identify issues related to motivating students.
Students will learn cognitive teaching strategies for creating interesting learning environments.
Students will understand issues related to cognition, intelligence, and classroom assessment.
Students will refine their own philosophy of teaching and use cognitive principles in evaluating a unit of instruction.
Students will apply the cognition concepts they have learned in the course to answer questions about educational issues.
topics: Curriculum Applications: Mathematics, Science, Social Studies, Art, Music, and Physical Education
